title: Contest Scoreboard
intro: Good afternoon, dear. The school contest is tomorrow, and our scoreboard is still blank.
Each team needs its score and a “+1” button. And a “Reset” button, for when the contest starts over.
Careful: last year's board never changed when you pressed it. A scoreboard has to remember the score!
My sketch is up on the sign board. Press Run whenever you want me to take a look!
celebration: Blue two, Green one… and back to zero! Perfect, dear.
thanks: The children will love it. Class dismissed — the school is open!
request: Our scoreboard needs to count! Show "Blue: 0" and "Green: 0", a "+1 Blue" and a "+1 Green" button that add a point to their team, and a "Reset" button that puts both back to 0.

criteria.description: Pressing "+1 Blue" gives Blue a point
criteria.message: The children cheered, but the board didn't count it…

criteria.description: Green's point doesn't change Blue's score
criteria.message: Each team earns its own points, dear.
Tomorrow is a new contest. Reset should wipe the board clean!
